title: Inward shift with an empty donor
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $i$ satisfy $1\le i<\ell$, and assign a finite word of optional Boolean values to each of the $\ell$ zones. If the word in zone $i-1$ is empty, then after shifting inward at level $i$, the word in zone $i-1$ is the first $2^{i-1}$ entries of the original word in zone $i$, and the word in zone $i$ is the remainder after those entries are removed.
